item.title: It is 2026. Why are your object mappings still strings?
item.description:
The setup

Mapping one Java object to another is routine work in most apps, and MapStruct, the standard tool for it, still has you name each field with a string: @Mapping(source = "customerName", target = "fullName"). Those two names are what the whole mapping turns on, and they are strings: rename the field and they stay exactly as they were.

MapStruct earned its place. Ten years, a huge adopter base, a bug list that converged long ago, and it generates genuinely fast code; I reach for it too. Those strings are just the one piece of its 2014 design that aged badly.
